title: The Kids and the Kit
lines: Ten kids got a big kit.
In it: a net, a pen, and a pad!
"Can I get the net?" said a kid.
The kids did dig a pit in the mud.
A big bug got in the pit!
A kid got the bug in the net.
"It is not a pet," said Mom.
The kids did tip the bug in the mud.

questions.listenFor: A net, a pen, and a pad. The story lists all three. If your child names one, have them read that line again.

questions.ask: What did the kids do with the bug at the end?
questions.listenFor: They tipped it back into the mud and let it go. Listen for letting it go, not keeping it.

questions.ask: Do you think a bug makes a good pet? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. You are listening for a reason, and a reason pulled from the story is best of all.
